company.name: Physics Wallah (PW)
company.description: PW is an Indian ed-tech platform offering affordable courses for Class 6–12, JEE, NEET, UPSC, GATE and several other competitive exams.

faq.question: What is Physics Wallah?
faq.answer: Physics Wallah (PW) is an Indian online education platform offering high-quality classes for school students and competitive exam aspirants. They provide live classes, recorded lectures, notes, test series, and mentorship.

faq.question: Who founded Physics Wallah?
faq.answer: PW was founded by Alakh Pandey in 2016.

faq.question: What courses does Physics Wallah offer?
faq.answer: PW offers courses for Classes 6–12 (CBSE/State Boards), JEE, NEET, GATE, UPSC, SSC, Banking, and foundation batches for early years.

faq.question: Does Physics Wallah offer free content?
faq.answer: Yes. PW provides free notes, NCERT solutions, topic videos, and free YouTube classes.

faq.question: Does PW provide live or recorded classes?
faq.answer: PW provides both live classes and recorded lectures for flexible learning.

faq.question: How can I enroll in a PW batch?
faq.answer: Visit the official PW website or app, choose your batch, and complete payment to enroll.

faq.question: Does PW provide doubt-solving?
faq.answer: Yes. Many paid batches include dedicated doubt-solving via chat, live sessions, or doubt faculties.

faq.question: Is there a refund policy?
faq.answer: PW generally does NOT offer refunds after enrollment unless stated otherwise on a specific batch page.

faq.question: What languages are batches available in?
faq.answer: Most batches are available in Hinglish (Hindi + English). Some batches are offered in pure Hindi or English.

faq.question: Does PW provide tests and mock exams?
faq.answer: Yes. Batches typically include weekly tests, mock exams, and full-length test series.

faq.question: Can I watch lectures multiple times?
faq.answer: Yes. Recorded lectures can be watched multiple times through the PW app or website.

faq.question: Does PW provide printed books?
faq.answer: Some batches include printed books or the option to buy PW Pathshala books.

faq.question: How affordable are PW courses?
faq.answer: PW is known for providing courses at very low and accessible prices (₹500–₹6000 range).

faq.question: Does PW offer doubt solving after class?
faq.answer: Yes. Most batches offer doubt support after class through chat or live doubt-solving sessions.

faq.question: Does Physics Wallah have offline centers?
faq.answer: Yes. PW Vidyapeeth centers operate in various cities for offline coaching.

faq.question: Is there a free trial?
faq.answer: PW does not typically offer free trials but provides free sample lectures on YouTube.

faq.question: Does PW offer EMI?
faq.answer: Some high-value programs may offer EMI through third-party partners.

faq.question: How long does batch access last?
faq.answer: Depending on the batch, access typically lasts until the exam year (e.g., JEE/NEET 2026).

faq.question: Can I change batches later?
faq.answer: Batch changes are usually not allowed unless explicitly mentioned.

faq.question: Do I need a laptop to attend classes?
faq.answer: No. You can attend all sessions through a mobile phone using the PW app.

faq.question: Are assignments provided?
faq.answer: Yes. Many batches include daily practice problems and homework.

faq.question: Will I get mentorship?
faq.answer: Premium batches include mentorship channels and doubt mentors.

faq.question: What exams does PW focus on the most?
faq.answer: PW is widely known for JEE and NEET preparation courses.

faq.question: Does PW provide English-medium JEE/NEET batches?
faq.answer: Yes, although most popular batches are in Hinglish.
